svg.text: Known: Brilliant Labs Frame drives this panel class with an 8-bit YCbCr

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: parallel bus plus SPI configuration (Frame hardware docs).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Not known: Sony publishes no datasheet, so connector pinout, the panel

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rail voltages and the init sequence are unverified. Treat the panel side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of this sheet as a signal list, not a pinout.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bus budget: ~17 signals; Pico 2 has 26 GPIO, so the IMU fits on I2C too.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Level shifting assumes 1.8 V panel logic; drop the shifters if it is 3.3 V.

svg.text: PMOD 1A + 1B as a double PMOD: 16 I/O for D0–D7 and the four timing lines;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: PMOD 2 for SPI config + XCLR. Same level shifters. Toolchain: Yosys + nextpnr.

svg.text: Reference: Frame's RTL (check its license before reuse).

svg.text: VSYS comes from the Pod-0 puck tether (sheet P-3).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: GPIO20 is the fuel-gauge alert on Pod-0: leave

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the optional gauge off, or move the UART pins.
